title: 대수기하학 원론 (EGA) — 한국어 누적판 / Éléments de géométrie algébrique — Korean Cumulative Edition
description:
Éléments de géométrie algébrique — Korean Cumulative Edition (대수기하학 원론 (EGA) — 한국어 누적판), release 2026-08-29-r31.

This independently maintained cumulative reader preserves every Korean EGA unit that has passed the project’s source, translation, typesetting, and deterministic QA gates. The present edition contains complete Korean EGA 0_I and EGA I; the complete EGA II Chapter II programme; and a contiguous translation of EGA II §1 through §1.7.10, corresponding to canonical French source ega2-1-fr.tex lines 1–1116. EGA II and the complete EGA corpus remain incomplete; no claim of corpus completion, finality, infallibility, or external human certification is made.

Use the stable edition DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21921513 for the evolving Korean lineage and the exact-version DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22151448 for this immutable r31 checkpoint. The public working repository is github.com/KokunoYumeto/ega-ko. Earlier exact-version records and release directories remain immutable historical checkpoints.

The r31 increment translates the complete post-§1.7.8 correspondence paragraph and environments §1.7.9–§1.7.10 from canonical lines 1049–1116. It preserves the canonical correspondences among morphisms X→V(E), algebra homomorphisms S(E)→A(X), and module homomorphisms E→f_*O_X; the identification of the sheaf of germs of local sections with the dual; the canonical zero section; the historical field-valued definition of geometric points; and the description of the K-rational geometric fibre over a point. Stalk E_s, residue-field fibre E^s=E_s/m_sE_s, and scalar-extended pullback remain explicitly distinguished, including the source’s final “E^s or K finite-dimensional” condition.

The admitted canonical prefix is 49,912 LF-terminal UTF-8 bytes with SHA-256 B784020F4B5F1D9A9F0BC4EA023C54EA03408CF0479DEFBEA6B0CFD5B896FFE5. The new source slice is 3,505 LF-terminal UTF-8 bytes with SHA-256 23EDE365C2DE799F6D07C43EC268616101C86F2C2F00F034DB4943551FD328D0. The Korean target is 50,714 bytes with SHA-256 48983F35AB77D62B36B903168785834D88418E296283286D2C5375A7FDC9A281; its admitted increment is 3,536 LF-terminal UTF-8 bytes with SHA-256 456C2929A709D6D0EABF3271CDBC16284CF6233F51DF3EFA7645B88DAD7616E1. The cumulative PDF has 232 pages, 1,447,261 bytes, and SHA-256 0DA482A847F2984C9B3C2E27AD18A98DDCB23D593E9C2C0499573569A58FA281.

The edition retains 221 historical printed-page markers as an explicit source-page rhythm. Its build is fail-closed on input identity, ordering, admitted source boundary, and target hashes. Release evidence includes editable TeX, the cumulative coverage matrix, source-authority records, terminology decisions, translation-admission controls, reproducible XeLaTeX logs, independent text extractions, replacement-character checks, internal-link and named-destination resolution, selected 200-dpi visual renders, and cryptographic inventories. These checks are deliberately hard and reproducible: they establish the tested properties and exact bytes, but they do not prove that the translation or edition is perfect. Confirmed defects and documented uncertainties are handled through later immutable versions.

The historical creators are Alexander Grothendieck and Jean Dieudonné. AI typesetting & translation is the sole standardized project contributor. The project is independent: the historical authors, NUMDAM, IHÉS, source publishers, repositories, and cited third parties do not endorse this translation.
